The '''NovaCluster Players''' was an itinerating troupe of actors led by [[Ahric Korownosek]].

==History==
The '''NovaCluster Players''' was an itinerating troupe of actors led by [[Ahric Korownosek]]. During their first days, the Players achieved an amount of success and money. Korownosek used this riches to uy a [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili]]-[[Surron StarTech|Surron]] [[Starlight-class light freighter|''Starlight''-class light freighter]], the ''[[Command Performance]]'', with which they would travel from one world to another. He used further gains to customize it, adding space for actors, props, costumes and a stage, as well as a library.

Nonetheless, the NovaCluster Players were reduced to act in backwater worlds performing ''[[Coruscani and I]]'', ''[[The Glorious Rise of the New Order]]'' and [[Sing, Advisors, Sing!|''Sing, Advisors, Sing'']]
